description: This file defines the Git::SVN::Migration module, containing functions for migrating and managing SVN layout versions within a Git repository, including layout version detection, migration routines, and connection minimization.

methods.name: migrate_from_v0
methods.description: Migrates repository layout from version 0 to newer formats by renaming refs based on URL info.

methods.name: migrate_from_v1
methods.description: Migrates repository layout from version 1 to newer formats, copying data from old SVN directories.

methods.name: read_old_urls
methods.description: Recursively reads old URL mappings from SVN info directories.

methods.name: migrate_from_v2
methods.description: Migrates repository layout from version 2 by initializing SVN remotes based on URL mappings.

methods.name: minimize_connections
methods.description: Optimizes SVN remote connections by consolidating URLs and updating config accordingly.

methods.name: migration_check
methods.description: Performs sequential migration checks and optional connection minimization.
